author: AtditC
body:
hi.

I usually play survival games on another minecraft server if Avicus is down etc.
My favorite sg-server is very big, there exists an achievement system. If you get the first kill in a 24 player match, you get the achievement "First Blood" etc.
I thought this is a good idea for our Avicus-XP-System.
Ex. If destroy all monuments in a match, you'll get the achievement "All by myself" +50XP or if you kill three players in a row, you'll get "OH BABY A TRIPPLE!!" +25XP :D etc.. There will be more reasons for playing Avicus and people would have more fun, Avicus won't be boring for all players, even if they already have prestige 15 like Sunny. He's like 'done' with nebula, he just finished it. But aiming for achievements will be more fun to get XP, maybe there also could be stats on the website. Example: 

attention!! xxx_dux__xxx is going to quicksc0pe you!!!
People also can suggest more achievements to get in form of a post below.
On your profile:

The black font is for achievements which are done, they grey font is for achievements, which are'n done yet.

-4td!t
